set.text:
Many people think sunscreen is only necessary at the beach, but dermatologists say that sunlight can damage skin even on a cloudy day, when the weather seems harmless and the sun is hard to see. Health experts therefore give several pieces of advice that are worth knowing before the summer begins.

(A) They also advise applying it again every two hours when you are outside, because sweat and water gradually wash it away.

(B) Because of these rays, doctors recommend putting sunscreen on every morning, particularly on the face, neck and hands, which are always exposed.

(C) The main reason is that ultraviolet rays pass through thin clouds, so a gray sky may still deliver most of the harmful energy.

qs.q: What is the most natural order of (A), (B) and (C) after the given paragraph?
qs.why: 각 문단의 첫머리 단서(연결어·시간 표현·지시어)를 따라가면 순서가 정해져요. 이유(C) → ‘these rays’를 받는 권고(B) → ‘They also advise’ 추가 권고(A) 순이에요.

qs.q: Why can a cloudy day still harm the skin?
o: Clouds make the air much hotter.
Sunscreen stops working in the shade.
Ultraviolet rays can pass through thin clouds.
The sun is closer on gray days.
qs.why: 얇은 구름을 자외선이 통과하기 때문이에요.

qs.q: Which parts of the body are described as always exposed?
o: The back, legs and feet
The arms, knees and ears
The hair, nose and shoulders
The face, neck and hands
qs.why: (B)에서 얼굴, 목, 손이 항상 노출된다고 말해요.

qs.q: Why should people apply sunscreen again?
o: The first layer becomes too thick.
Sunlight changes the color of the skin.
Sweat and water gradually wash it away.
Clouds move during the afternoon.
qs.why: 땀과 물이 선크림을 씻어내기 때문이에요.

patches.why: (B) 'As a result' could directly follow the intro, making (B)-(A)-(C) defensible; 'these rays' now forces (C) first. Q2 explanation 'second paragraph' was ambiguous.

set.q:
Choose the most natural order of the sentences.
Our school library recently introduced a new rule about borrowing books.
(A) To prevent this, every book must now be returned within two weeks, so more readers can enjoy it.
(B) Previously, students could keep a book for as long as they wished.
(C) As a result, popular titles often disappeared from the shelves for months.
set.why: 연결어와 지시어, 시간 표현을 단서로 순서를 정해요. 과거의 상황(Previously) → 결과(As a result) → 문제를 막기 위한 새 규칙(To prevent this) 순서예요.

patches.why: (A)-(B)-(C) was also natural (rule stated right after the intro, then 'Previously'). (A) now begins 'To prevent this', which requires (C) before it. Changes q (identity field).

Ordering question has two identical tokens 'I' (answer checked by token id, so a correct sentence with them swapped is marked wrong) and the word order is not unique (I would have left earlier had I known...).

criteria: single defensible answer (blind solve), natural English, level, distractor validity, hint and explanation
